reason: NASA catalog candidates were found, but bounded Earthdata raster-access attempts returned no usable classified pixels. No seasonal pair is integrated.
method: DSWx-HLS WTR: 0 non-water; 1 open water and 2 partial surface water form the water-classified footprint; all other classes unknown. This is pixel footprint, not fractional water area.
limitations: Two dates do not establish permanent or year-round water.
Seasonal differences are not validated flood extent.
Analysis rectangle is not an official Ramsar boundary.
